keyEvents.text: Goal! Le Havre 1, Paris Saint Germain 0. Josh Maja (Le Havre) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Rayan Fofana following a fast break.
Goal! Le Havre 1, Paris Saint Germain 1. Mika Godts (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Achraf Hakimi.

Goal! Le Havre 1, Paris Saint Germain 2. Achraf Hakimi (Paris Saint Germain) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Senny Mayulu with a through ball.Goal awarded following VAR Review.
Goal! Le Havre 1, Paris Saint Germain 3. Achraf Hakimi (Paris Saint Germain) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.

Goal! Le Havre 1, Paris Saint Germain 4. Senny Mayulu (Paris Saint Germain) left footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Achraf Hakimi with a through ball following a fast break.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Beraldo replaces Maghnes Akliouche.
Substitution, Le Havre. Mbwana Samatta replaces Sota Nakamura.
Substitution, Le Havre. Enzo Koffi replaces Amir Richardson.
Substitution, Le Havre. Rassoul Ndiaye replaces Lamine N'Diaye.
Goal! Le Havre 1, Paris Saint Germain 5. Achraf Hakimi (Paris Saint Germain) with an attempt from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. Quentin Ndjantou replaces Mika Godts.
Substitution, Paris Saint Germain. David Boly replaces Achraf Hakimi.
Substitution, Le Havre. Hakim Dongopandji replaces Rayan Fofana.
Substitution, Le Havre. Daren Mosengo replaces Simon Ebonog.
Second Half ends, Le Havre 1, Paris Saint Germain 5.
